name: @w6w-apps/respondio
description: Manage contacts, conversations, and messages across WhatsApp, SMS, and other channels via the respond.io Developer API.

w6w.longDescription:
respond.io unifies WhatsApp, SMS, Messenger, Instagram, email and other channels into one contact-and-conversation inbox. This app covers the respond.io Developer API v2's five areas: Contacts (create/read/update/delete, upsert, merge, tag, list with field/tag/lifecycle filters), Conversations (assign, open/close), Messaging (send any of the six documented message shapes — text, attachment, WhatsApp template, email, quick reply, custom payload — and read message history), Comments (internal notes on a contact), and Space (workspace users, custom fields, closing notes, channels, WhatsApp templates, and tags).

There is no OAuth surface for third-party apps: a personal API access token, minted per-workspace under Settings > Integrations > Developer API, is the entire authentication story.
